title: A board write that cannot reach origin writes a worktree's card file in place, and it can ride a merge
notes: board-program.ts writeHere fallback: when the sync to origin fails, a card write from a worktree lands in the worktree's .dashboard/board/cards/, gets committed with the work and merged onto main with a stale column. Today 2 of ~8 board writes from the main checkout failed 'cannot fetch origin/main' and worked on retry, so the fallback is hit in practice. Retry the fetch before falling back, and keep a fallback write out of the branch's commits (or refuse it in a worktree). Split out of bcb5f09e / #321, 2026-11-17.

comments.body: Pull request #322 opened: Board: a write that cannot reach origin is refused in a worktree, and a dropped connection is retried https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/322

Review loop: floor-addressed after 2 rounds (commits c080217c merge of main, 5a1620ce, 0140b1d0); the card file is now main's copy and out of the diff. NOT ready to merge: main took #317 during the loop and the PR conflicts again in docs/board/README.md, src/main/board/board-program.ts, board-program.test.ts, board-sync-git.ts. CI not waited on because of the conflict. The last fix round (dropped-push refusal wording, 'rejected 3 times' wording) has no re-review behind it.

Converged, ready to merge. Merged main (#317) in (6f491b19): kept both the seeded-docs sync and the retry/worktree refusal; a worktree whose read wrote a seeded doc origin could not take now gets it put back, with a test. Windows CI had been failing since 5a1620ce: the dropped-connection tests fake the drop with a POSIX shell script, now skipped on win32 (b73157ce). Head b73157ce: CI 5/5 green, mergeable.
